personality_voice.book_baseline: Across all seven books Hermione's personality is defined by interlocking traits: intellectual compulsion (hand always up, cannot suppress the urge to answer correctly), rule-following instinct combined with a capacity to break rules when loyalty or principle demands it, emotional volatility beneath a composed surface (crying in bathrooms, attacking Ron with birds, hysterical hand-flapping over OWLs), sharp corrective wit, moral earnestness bordering on self-righteousness, social anxiety masked by academic confidence, and a Muggle-born insecurity that drives her obsessive preparation. Her voice is verbose, self-interrupting, lecture-cadenced, and tonally variable — she can be clipped and cold, breathlessly anxious, or warmly loyal within the same scene. The contradictions are central: she is the most rule-bound student and the most effective rule-breaker; she craves acceptance but consistently alienates people; she is intellectually fearless but emotionally brittle.
personality_voice.film_portrayal: The films preserve the dominant surface traits consistently across all eight entries: Hermione answers before others process the question, corrects pronunciation, enforces rules selectively, delivers sharp dry lines, and shows emotional investment in Harry and Ron. Key individual moments work well — the birds and Oppugno scene, the 'emotional range of a teaspoon' line, the fake-crying gambit, the 'Always the tone of surprise' reveal, the Yule Ball confrontation. Her competence and loyalty are never in doubt. Across the series she is recognisably the same character in every film.
personality_voice.difference: The consistent loss across all films is tonal range and the anxious, brittle, socially complicated texture that the books accumulate through repetition. The sustained patterns — weeks of competitive resentment over the Prince's book, the Firebolt estrangement, the SPEW obsessiveness that alienates Hagrid and frightens house-elves, the repeated Snape hand-ignoring humiliations, the OWL hysterics, the boggart revealing her fear of failure — are either absent or compressed to single moments. Film Hermione defaults more quickly to composed and supportive. The prickly, moralistic, occasionally infuriating register that is as central to book-Hermione as her competence is systematically softened. The voice is right in its clearest individual expressions but the sustained accumulation of personality texture is missing.
personality_voice.evidence_status: Directly evidenced across all seven per-book analyses
personality_voice.penalty_logic: The core personality is present and consistently rendered — no film misrepresents who she is. The penalty reflects the uniform compression of secondary texture: the anxious, bossy, emotionally volatile, socially maladroit registers that give the book character her contradictions. This is a moderate and consistent simplification across all films, not a severe distortion. Weighted average of per-book scores (20, 21, 18, 17, 20, 20, 21) is approximately 19.6, rounded to 19 after applying a mild synthesis penalty for the systematic pattern of simplification that is more visible across the whole series than in any single book.

narrative_role_agency.book_baseline: Hermione is a co-protagonist across the series, not a supporting character. She drives or co-drives plot resolution in every book: the Polyjuice plan (CoS), Buckbeak's defence and time-travel (PoA), the Rita Skeeter investigation (GoF), the DA's creation and organisational infrastructure (OotP), the Horcrux research and Half-Blood Prince identity (HBP), and the entire expedition's logistical and intellectual backbone (DH). Several of her book contributions are her most important individual moments: the potion puzzle (PS), Eileen Prince discovery (HBP), Basilisk identification while Petrified (CoS), the Galleon Protean Charm (OotP). She initiates independently, challenges leadership, and is the research engine for the central plot throughout.
narrative_role_agency.film_portrayal: Her role as intellectual resource and emotional anchor is preserved across all films and she retains agency in plot-essential moments. The Polyjuice plan, the Devil's Snare, the DA pitch, the Ministry infiltration, the Gringotts escape, the cup stabbing — these are all hers. She is never reduced to decoration and is consistently the most prepared person present.
narrative_role_agency.difference: The systematic loss is her sustained independent agency across multiple scenes. The potion puzzle (PS) is removed entirely. SPEW and its multi-chapter independence (GoF, OotP) is entirely absent. The Horcrux library research (HBP) is absent. The Eileen Prince discovery (HBP) is absent. The Buckbeak research campaign (PoA) is compressed. The sustained Occlumency advocacy, Hagrid protection, and DA organisational infrastructure (OotP) are reduced to single lines. The pattern across all films is: Hermione retains agency in set-piece moments but loses agency in the sustained, independently-initiated contributions that define her as a co-protagonist. Her role shifts from co-protagonist to smart, essential companion.
narrative_role_agency.evidence_status: Directly evidenced across all per-book analyses
narrative_role_agency.penalty_logic: Multiple specific acts of agency are removed across the series without transfer — the potion puzzle, the Horcrux research, SPEW, the Eileen Prince investigation. No single film removes her entirely from the plot, but the cumulative loss of independently-initiated, sustained narrative contributions is the largest single faithfulness failure across the adaptation. Weighted average of per-book scores (16, 17, 13, 14, 16, 15, 16) is approximately 15.3, reduced to 14 after synthesis penalty for the systematic pattern of agency compression.

motivations_internal_conflict.book_baseline: Hermione's motivations across the series are layered and consistent: intellectual compulsion and the need to prove herself (Muggle-born anxiety driving obsessive preparation), loyalty to Harry and Ron that repeatedly overrides her stated principles, moral conviction about justice for marginalised groups (SPEW, Kreacher, house-elves throughout), a specific tension between her rule-following instinct and her willingness to break rules when the stakes are high enough, romantic feeling for Ron that she suppresses and redirects, and a deep need for external validation beneath her confidence. These motivations interact and conflict visibly across the series.
motivations_internal_conflict.film_portrayal: The films preserve the two primary motivations consistently: loyalty to Harry and Ron, and the rules-versus-principles tension. The romantic motivation for Ron is present across the relevant films. The DH opening memory-charm sequence makes her sacrifice for her parents more emotionally vivid than the book achieves through narration.
motivations_internal_conflict.difference: The moral justice motivation — SPEW, Kreacher advocacy, house-elf welfare — is almost entirely absent across all films. The Muggle-born anxiety as a specific psychological driver is present in CoS but absent or underplayed elsewhere. The intellectual-pride motivation (the need to be the most prepared, the competitive insecurity over the Prince's book) is rendered in individual moments but never as a sustained characterisation device. The internal conflict around Harry's leadership (OotP, DH) is softened. The result is a motivational profile that is correct in outline — loyal, principled, rules-versus-conviction — but missing the moral stubbornness and the Muggle-born anxiety that give it its full texture.
motivations_internal_conflict.evidence_status: Directly evidenced across all per-book analyses
motivations_internal_conflict.penalty_logic: Motivations are simplified but not inverted. The primary drivers are present and legible in the films. The systematic loss of the SPEW/house-elf moral motivation across GoF, OotP, and DH is the most consistent omission. Weighted average of per-book scores (12, 13, 11, 11, 12, 13, 13) is approximately 12.1, rounded to 11 after mild synthesis penalty for the recurring absence of the moral-justice motivation strand.

character_arc.book_baseline: Hermione's arc across the series runs from isolated, friendless rule-enforcer to tested, battle-scarred adult who has sacrificed her family and her safety for a cause. The key arc stages are: the troll friendship breakthrough (PS), the rule-breaking escalation and earned reconciliation with Ron (PoA), the social confidence and moral agency development (GoF), the growing conviction and willingness to defy institutions (OotP), the confrontation with her own limits and the cost of loyalty (HBP — the sustained Ron estrangement and intellectual humiliation), and the final tested loyalty of the camping months and the war (DH). Within individual books the arc is often flat (she begins and ends as competent Hermione) but the steps within each book — and the accumulation across all seven — constitute a genuine developmental trajectory.
character_arc.film_portrayal: The major arc beats are present: the troll friendship (PS), the time-travel rule-breaking (PoA), the Yule Ball emotional confrontation (GoF), the DA co-founding (OotP), the Ron estrangement and reunion (HBP), the parents' sacrifice and sustained loyalty (DH). The endpoint is broadly consistent with the books — she is settled, mature, still partnered with Ron.
character_arc.difference: The consistent loss is the middle stages of each individual arc, which means the arcs arrive at correct endpoints without the earned journey. The Firebolt estrangement that gives the PoA reconciliation weight is absent. The sustained Ron-Lavender cold war that gives HBP its emotional middle is compressed. The SPEW arc that gives GoF's 'growing moral agency' dimension its substance is absent. The camping-months deterioration that makes DH's persistence feel hard-won is reduced to set pieces. Across the series, the film's Hermione lands in the right place without having clearly travelled the whole distance.
character_arc.evidence_status: Directly evidenced across all per-book analyses
character_arc.penalty_logic: Arc structure is present and sequenced correctly in every film. The systematic failure is in the middle stages — the intermediate steps that make the arc feel earned. No arc is reversed or falsified. Weighted average of per-book scores (11, 12, 11, 10, 13, 11, 12) is approximately 11.4, rounded to 11.

key_relationships.book_baseline: Hermione's three primary relational dynamics across the series are: Harry (intellectual partnership, emotional anchor, mutual reliance, she challenges him and commits to him unconditionally), Ron (complex friction-to-love arc, jealousy, dependency, pettiness, genuine warmth, culminating in the kiss), and within-book secondaries (Lupin, Sirius, Krum, Lockhart) that add relational texture. The Harry-Hermione dynamic is characterised by genuine intellectual partnership — she is not just his emotional support but his research engine. The Ron-Hermione dynamic is characterised by sustained damage-and-repair patterns across multiple books.
key_relationships.film_portrayal: The Harry-Hermione partnership is preserved in emotional function across all films. The Ron-Hermione arc hits its key dramatic beats: the Yule Ball confrontation (GoF), the Oppugno and hospital wing (HBP), the return punch and kiss (DH). The trio dynamic is intact as a structural unit.
key_relationships.difference: The Harry-Hermione intellectual partnership loses depth across multiple films because so much of what she does for Harry's central missions is cut (Horcrux research, Prince identity, SPEW contextualisation, extended Malfoy evidence debates). She functions more as emotional support than intellectual partner in several films. The Ron-Hermione relationship consistently loses the texture of its sustained damage-and-repair patterns — the specific weeks of estrangement that make reconciliations feel earned are compressed to individual scenes in PoA, GoF, HBP, and OotP. The relationship dynamic reads as playful friction rather than genuine rupture and repair.
key_relationships.evidence_status: Directly evidenced across all per-book analyses
key_relationships.penalty_logic: No relationship is fundamentally misrepresented or reversed. The penalty reflects consistent compression of relational texture — particularly the sustained damage-and-repair arc with Ron — across multiple films. Weighted average of per-book scores (8, 8, 7, 7, 7, 8, 8) is approximately 7.6, rounded to 7.

complexity_nuance_lost_material.book_baseline: Hermione's complexity across the series rests on contradictions that resist easy summary: she is the most rule-bound student and the most effective rule-breaker; she craves acceptance but consistently alienates people; she is intellectually fearless but emotionally brittle; she is morally passionate about causes (SPEW, house-elf welfare, Muggle-born rights) in ways that are socially costly and occasionally alienating rather than straightforwardly admirable. The material that carries this complexity includes: the boggart (PoA), the Firebolt arc (PoA), the deathday party social awkwardness (CoS), the potion puzzle articulating her specific intelligence (PS), SPEW and its alienating effects across three books (GoF, OotP, DH), the Eileen Prince investigation (HBP), the Snape hand-ignoring pattern (PS), her failure to find Horcrux information in the library (HBP), and the sustained camping-period texture (DH). These are the scenes that show her failing, being socially maladroit, being righteously annoying, and being anxious — the uncomfortable Hermione alongside the admirable one.
complexity_nuance_lost_material.film_portrayal: The films consistently preserve the positive, admirable Hermione: competent, loyal, brave, sharp-witted. Key individual complexity moments survive — the fake-crying gambit (OotP), the Oppugno scene (HBP), the memory-charm opening (DH), the Malfoy Manor quick thinking (DH), the Lockhart crush and embarrassment (CoS). Some uncomfortable moments survive: Ron's return punch (DH), the birds (HBP).
complexity_nuance_lost_material.difference: The systematic loss is exactly the material that makes Hermione uncomfortable or fallible: SPEW (entirely absent from all films), the boggart (absent), the Firebolt arc (absent from film canon), the deathday party (absent), the potion puzzle (absent), the Eileen Prince investigation (absent), the Horcrux library failure (absent), the sustained Snape humiliation pattern (reduced), the camping-period emotional texture (compressed). The film across the whole series gives the admirable Hermione with minimal exposure of the contradictions, obsessions, failures, and social costs that make the book character genuinely complex rather than just competent and kind.
complexity_nuance_lost_material.evidence_status: Directly evidenced across all per-book analyses
complexity_nuance_lost_material.penalty_logic: This is the most consistent and severe simplification across the adaptation. The missing material is not incidental — it is the primary vehicle for her character's complexity in most books. SPEW alone represents a multi-book characterisation device showing her acting on unpopular convictions regardless of social cost. Combined with the boggart, Firebolt arc, deathday party, potion puzzle, and Eileen Prince investigation, the total loss of complexity-bearing material is substantial. Weighted average of per-book scores (10, 10, 8, 8, 10, 10, 10) is approximately 9.4, rounded to 9.

comparative.key_observations: Across all eight films, the adaptation delivers a Hermione Granger who is faithful in her most visible traits — intellectual authority, loyal boldness, sharp wit, emotional investment in Harry and Ron — and consistently unfaithful in her contradictions and uncomfortable dimensions. The core identity is never misrepresented: every film's Hermione is recognisably the same person. The systematic failure is the removal of the material that makes her genuinely complex rather than just competent and kind. SPEW is the single largest omission across the series — a multi-book characterisation device showing her acting on unpopular moral convictions at social cost — and its complete absence from all films is the clearest marker of how the adaptation simplifies her. The other major losses (potion puzzle, Firebolt arc, boggart, Horcrux research, Eileen Prince investigation, deathday party, camping-period texture) collectively remove exactly the scenes where she fails, embarrasses herself, alienates others, or acts from obsession rather than wisdom. The film Hermione is the idealized version of herself: always essentially right, her flaws limited to reaction speed and emotional volatility in romantic contexts. The book Hermione is simultaneously the most admirable and the most irritating character in the series — righteously annoying, occasionally wrong, socially costly in her convictions, and anxious beneath her confidence. That second portrait is largely absent from the films. A total of 71 reflects a portrayal that is substantially faithful in character identity and primary narrative function, meaningfully simplified in the texture and contradictions that distinguish the book character, and consistently missing the material that would make a viewer of the films understand why Hermione is genuinely complex rather than just the smart one.
